title: KnowledgeBaseIndex
description: Contract between the preprocessing pipeline and dt-app-mcp. One entry per chunk; drives agent retrieval before any chunk file is loaded.

chunks.description: Ordered list of all chunks in the knowledge base.

ChunkEntry.description: Metadata the agent inspects to decide whether to load a chunk.

name.description: Short, human-readable identifier for the chunk (e.g. document title + section).

description.description: One-sentence summary of the chunk content used by the agent for retrieval decisions.

path.description: Path to the chunk file, relative to the repository root (forward slashes, no leading slash).
